description: Rainfall-induced hydroplaning risk over road infrastructure of the continental USA is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kaustubh Anil Salvi, Mukesh Kumar (Research scholar). The data and codes uploaded here can be used to quantify rainfall-induced hydroplaning risk for road accidents and its temporal evolution on account of variations in spatio-temporal patterns of precipitation under changing climate. The analysis is carried out over all the road sections within the continental USA. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
